name: Aqua Dome
kurzbeschreibung: Aqua Dome in Längenfeld is the Alps' premier thermal resort, featuring futuristic levitating thermal basins and extensive saunas.
preis: 3-hour thermal bath adults from approx. €32.00; day passes and sauna available
oeffnungszeiten: Open daily year-round from 09:00 to 23:00 (Fridays until midnight)
beschreibung:
Overview

The futuristic thermal wellness world Aqua Dome in Längenfeld in the central Ötztal is widely regarded as one of the architecturally most extraordinary and exclusive thermal spas in the entire alpine region. Nestled amidst the towering backdrop of the Ötztal three-thousand-meter giants at an elevation of 1,173 meters, this sprawling wellness haven captivates relaxation seekers, couples, and families alike. The iconic architectural hallmark of the complex consists of three futuristic levitating thermal bowl basins constructed of glass and steel, where bathers float in warm, mineral-rich thermal waters while snowy peaks mirror on the surface. The thermal spring rises from deep bedrock at 1,865 meters below ground, supplying diverse indoor and outdoor pools with healing waters renowned for their revitalising benefits.

Route & Requirements

Aqua Dome is designed as a luxury modern retreat and is completely threshold-free and barrier-free throughout. Wide hallways, spacious elevators, adapted changing rooms, and pool hoists ensure that guests with restricted mobility enjoy an unhindered spa stay. Standard swimwear, a bathrobe, and slip-resistant pool sandals are all that is required for a visit. The complex features dedicated thematic zones: the classical indoor thermal hall with twin pools, the expansive 'Gletscherglühen' sauna village offering aromatic infusions, the exclusive SPA 3000 for hotel guests, and the separate 'Alpen Arche Noah' water world for families, complete with giant water slides, children's pools, and supervised entertainment.

Visit & Arrival

Aqua Dome operates 365 days a year daily from 09:00 to 23:00, with popular moonlight bathing every Friday until midnight. Purchasing tickets and reserving lounge beds online in advance is highly recommended, especially on winter weekends and holidays. Arrive by car via the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Ötztal) and continue along the B186 federal road for approximately 25 kilometers into the valley to Längenfeld (free underground garage and outdoor parking provided). By rail, travel to Ötztal-Bahnhof station; from there, VVT regional buses run every half hour directly to the Längenfeld Therme bus stop.

Tips

Experience an evening dip in the floating brine basin with underwater acoustics and ambient lighting as twilight settles over the peaks of the Ötztal. In the sauna village, do not miss the signature glacier ice infusion, blending brisk cold therapy with native alpine botanical aromas.
